name: The Most Interesting Man in the World
look: An ad photo of actor Jonathan Goldsmith, with swept-back gray hair and a gray beard, in a black pinstriped jacket and white shirt, seated at a dark table with one arm across his chest and a green Dos Equis beer bottle beside him.
use: The top line is I don't always X and the bottom is but when I do, I Y, a suave, self-assured statement about a habit that usually ends in something oddly specific or ridiculous.
examples: I don't always go to the gym
but when I do, I take a selfie and leave
I don't always read the instructions
but when I do, it's after I've built it wrong
describe: older man with a gray beard sitting with a beer bottle
classy gray haired guy at a table looking confident
beer commercial man in a pinstripe suit
distinguished bearded gentleman staring at the camera at a bar
suave old man in a black jacket with a green bottle
origin: From a Dos Equis beer ad campaign starring actor Jonathan Goldsmith.
